comparison_authority.scope: Explicit user-selected visible linked spiral, taper and terminal curl; not hidden topology or new48 material/photography/dynamics approval.

visible_evidence: In normal scale and white/black3x, the two exposed narrow gray return sections pass obliquely between adjacent wide mint-facing turns; their ends visually reconnect with the turns above and below. They read as the same winding band continuing, rather than independent round plates with separate closed bottoms.

The lower wide front continues into a narrower descending band and a single inward C-shaped terminal curl. The final curl is attached to that path; the output does not stop in a capped lowest oval like ade931.
The spiral narrows along its visible run. The assessment rests on inter-turn return connections and lower-end continuity, not solely on an overall conical silhouette.

Gray return strips remain opaque on both QA backgrounds. They are not rejected for being gray, elliptical in projection, opaque, narrow or lacking a specified air-window count. No gray return should be deleted to manufacture a hole.
differences_to_user_example: Mint-facing broad areas occupy more of the visible turn than the narrow gray return strips; the material division is not a pixel copy of the selected old11 crop. This is a material/proportion observation, not by itself a sealed-stack finding.

The visible turns are more tightly spaced, and the terminal C looks relatively fuller against the upper turns. Its position/axis and exact count must not be frozen across poses. Root/Sol decide whether those visible differences are acceptable for this hair phase.
Light soft gray/mint color variation remains. Material cleanup, if ever separately authorized, must preserve the current continuous route, narrowing and attached terminal curl.
limitations: Only currently visible connections are assessed. Hidden backside topology, hidden length, exact dynamic match toR146, original1080 placement and continuous playback are not certified.
Current source hands/face/body/crop remain the original1012 authority. This geometry comparison does not resolve the separate whole-character camera placement or head/cap scale observations.
